sim.title: What if you spent less?
sim.subtitle: One slider per category. Move one and the month moves with it.
sim.errorTitle: This month's spending could not be read.
sim.errorMonth: There is no month to plan against.
sim.emptyBody: Nothing was spent in a category that month. Log an expense and come back.
sim.valueText: Cut {pct}. Saves {cut} a month, leaving {left} of {spent}.
sim.projIf: a month, if these cuts happen every month
sim.projNotYet: Not saved. This is what the cuts would add, while you keep them.
sim.projNoIncome: Spending less does not raise your income. It is the spending that stops.
sim.goalOf: Goal {goal} · {saved} in the jar · {remaining} to go
sim.goalMissing: No savings goal is set, so there is no number of months to give.
sim.monthsAbout: At {save} a month that is about {months} months away.
sim.monthsUnder: Less than a month: {remaining} to go, at {save} a month ({months}).
sim.monthsNone: No cut adds anything, so this does not reach the goal.
sim.monthsMet: The goal is already passed, by {amount}.
sim.basis: Worked out from {month} alone — one month, not an average.
sim.basisWhy: A month with a birthday in it is not your normal, so this plan may be too easy to keep.
sim.hidden.one: {n} category had nothing in it that month, so it has no slider.
sim.hidden.other: {n} categories had nothing in that month, so they have no slider.
sim.uncategorised: {amount} that month has no category, so no slider can reach it.
sim.moveFirst: Move a slider and there is something to save.
sim.writeConfirmBody.one: This writes {n} limit for {month}. A limit you already set is replaced.
sim.writeConfirmBody.other: This writes {n} limits for {month}. A limit you already set is replaced.
sim.writeConfirmNote: The number written is what is left after the cut — never what you spent.
sim.writePartial: {done} of {total} written. The rest did not save; nothing was undone.
sim.saveFailed: This device would not keep the plan. Nothing was saved.
sim.clearedToast: The saved plan is gone from this device.
sim.savedNote: Kept on this device, not on your account. It will not follow you to another device.
sim.restoredNote: The sliders below were loaded from a plan saved on this device.
